    • getUniqueTags

      public static Set<String> getUniqueTags(Collection<String> entries, boolean spaceDelimited)
      Gets the sorted set of unique custom tags found in a collection of entries
      Parameters:
      entries - the entries (e.g., list entries or Path names)
      spaceDelimited - if true, tag blocks are delimited by " {" (list entries). If false the opening brace may directly follow the text (Path names)
      See Also:
      • TagChips.parseCustom(String, boolean)

      Replaces all custom tags of an entry. An empty collection removes all tags
